summary: Iteration 3 testing of roles, granular permissions, audit log, and POS 3-columns UI. Backend: 30/30 pytest passed (test_roles_audit.py). Frontend: sidebar filtering per role, POS 3-columns for admin (products/lines/qty/price inputs), vendeur restrictions (no price-input, discount limit warning, checkout disabled), /users permissions dialog, /audit page filters, caissier /pos redirect to /dashboard - all verified.

issues: Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warning (a11y minor, non-blocking)

GET /api/auth/me returns full permissions payload
GET /api/auth/permissions-catalog returns roles/modules/flags
POST /api/auth/register without token -> 403
POST /api/auth/register with admin token creates user (200)
POST /api/auth/register with gerant token creating admin -> 403

Regression: admin POST /api/sales OK, POST /api/sales/{id}/cancel OK with audit action=cancel entry, admin POST /api/orders OK, customer statement OK
Frontend admin sidebar has all 16 nav items incl. nav-pos/nav-cash/nav-users/nav-audit/nav-settings

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1665 lines; consider splitting auth/users/audit/permissions into a separate module for maintainability.
effective_permissions() correctly strips 'pos' from caissier and 'users/audit/settings' from non-gerant; admin bypass explicit. Good.

audit_logs.created_at is stored as ISO string and filtered via lexicographic $gte/$lte on that string — works because ISO 8601 is sortable, but end_date branch only appends 'T23:59:59.999999' if len==10; if user passes full datetime they don't get boundary correction. Minor.

log_audit stores before/after via _clean which strips only _id and password; consider stripping full password hash for user updates. Currently update path builds 'after' dict without password ok, but before uses target which excludes password already. OK.
Frontend POSPage checks maxDiscount via subtotal*maxDiscountPct/100; matches backend guard (pct = discount/subtotal*100). Consistent.
